snippet.title: Plants Vs. Zombies First Person Updates & Future of the Game
snippet.description:
I spent way too much time on this video...
Thank You to everyone who has been playing or following the game, sorry that things don't release consistently.

Make sure to check out our new account, Tasty Sleep. The stuff we'll be posting on here won't be in the same style as our PVZ games, but if you like puzzles & mystery you should check it out:
https://tastysleep.itch.io

Download PVZ first-person here:
https://itch.io/c/2737608/pvz-first-person-series

Join the PVZ first-person Discord for behind-the-scenes screenshots:
 https://discord.gg/psDuxf4qPW 

Watch more PVZFP vids here:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL9yXF1Z_3Q98g7qulrKkXuPtTDSNv9Uqw
